PLAN 04 | SHOTS 09-11 | THE CAPTURE
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 3 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.
CHARACTER REFERENCES
CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
CHAR_ARNAVAZ = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
CHAR_MUSICIAN = {{CHAR_MUSICIAN}}
CHAR_GUARD_A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
CHAR_GUARD_B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
CHAR_GUARD_C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
ANIMAL REFERENCES
ANIMAL_CAT = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM = {{LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM}}
PROP REFERENCES
PROP_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN = {{PROP_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_CAPTURE. The door is open. Shahrnaz stands left, cat supported by both forearms against her chest. Arnavaz stands nearer the doorway on the right. A takes Shahrnaz’s left upper sleeve; B takes Arnavaz’s right forearm; C approaches her left side. The musician and broken instrument remain by the wall.

SHOT 09 | 00:00-00:05 | SHAHRNAZ CLOSES INWARD
40mm tight handheld medium shot. A grips Shahrnaz by the fabric of her left upper arm. She takes one backward step and turns her torso to shield the cat, both forearms still supporting it. Her shoulders lock and her head drops; A pulls her toward the exit.
SHOT 10 | 00:05-00:11 | ARNAVAZ PUSHES BACK
Cut to 28mm hip-height beside Arnavaz. She braces both feet and pushes B’s chest away with her left palm while he holds her right forearm. C reaches her left upper arm from behind. The camera shifts with her attempt to turn toward Shahrnaz, retaining all three bodies in readable overlap.
SHOT 11 | 00:11-00:15 | THE JAMB
Cut to 50mm at the open doorway. A and Shahrnaz pass first, cat visible against her chest. Arnavaz briefly hooks her left fingers around the jamb; C peels that hand away while B draws her forward. Cut on the hand releasing stone. The musician and broken instrument stay inside.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
Preserve warm window light and the narrow cold doorway spill. Focus follows grasping hands and body weight rather than facial expressions.
SOUND
Sleeves under tension, scraping soles, short breaths, palm against stone, the cat’s quiet breathing. The sound remains close and dry.
END STATE AND EDIT
A escorts Shahrnaz through the doorway first; she still supports the living cat. B and C control Arnavaz’s upper arms behind them. Her left hand has just lost contact with the door jamb.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.
